`qwen35_2b_15852e8_chat_template.jinja` is the unmodified tokenizer chat template
from `Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B`, revision
`15852e8c16360a2fea060d615a32b45270f8a8fc`.

It was copied from the node's pinned Hugging Face snapshot. The local and node
SHA-256 were independently verified as
`273d8e0e683b885071fb17e08d71e5f2a5ddfb5309756181681de4f5a1822d80`.
Tests use this fixture to reproduce the real single-leading-system restriction
without downloading models or requiring a GPU.
